The standard image of a live band followed a predictable blueprint for decades: boys with long hair on guitars, bass and drums, with one of them leading the act with a mic in hand. The layout, however, is a bit different today, as women have entered the male-dominated scene with a bass guitar slung across their shoulders, not just a conventional electric guitar or keyboards.
India never had many dedicated bassists. Guitarists often switched to bass at gigs or studio sessions. Those days are over, as women take the lead now in bands as bassists.
